paper_title: Improved limits on the coupling of ultralight bosonic dark matter to photons from optical atomic clock comparisons
coupling_convention: dimensionless d_e (scalar photon coupling as in L = phi*(d_e/4mu0)*F^2)
notes: PTB optical clock comparison (171Yb+ E3/E2 interleaved single-ion ratio, ~235 days over 26 months, and Yb+ E3 vs 87Sr lattice clock, ~343 h over 41 days) constraining oscillations of alpha and hence scalar photon coupling d_e for m ~ 1e-24 to 2e-17 eV. No numerical table given; data_points reconstructed from Eq. (8) |d_e| = 3 * omega * A_omega / k_alpha * sqrt(c^2/(8 pi G rho_DM)) using text-quoted values: flat amplitude bound A ~ 2e-17 for E3/E2 (k_alpha = 6.95) above 1/T ~ 1.6e-8 Hz (with 1/omega^2 degradation below), and A ~ 7e-18 for E3/Sr (k_alpha = 6.01) dominating above ~1e-20 eV; rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3; stochastic-field factor 3 included as stated in paper. Points are an approximate envelope of the two datasets and should be treated as ~factor-2 accurate; exact curve is in Fig. 4 (not machine-readable here).
